FN-NULYJJT-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 303
Committee: County and Municipal Sponsor: Representative Mark Shirey
Government
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 03/19/2024
House Bill 303 as introduced would increase the proclamation expenses of the Governor, paid
from the State General Fund, by an estimated $100,000 for the fiscal year ending September 30,
2025 by proposing an amendment to the Constitution of Alabama 2022. This bill would not
otherwise affect state or local funding.
Page 1
